objective: CE + 0.1 causal repeated-fourgram completion unlikelihood within past64 completion positions on unique non-special candidates excluding the true next token; same raw targets
initialization: Our Round11 latest model + AdamW moments + Torch/Python RNG; hold terminal learning rate
schedule: Hold exact Round11 terminal LR throughout additional10000; preserve moments and RNG, no restart
validationStatus: Previously exposed development sources; not independent unseen validation
batching: Conditional length buckets64/128/256; same marginal row probabilities, correlated batch lengths; no target truncation. Different update trajectory from unbucketed pilots.
selection: Lowest weighted development segmentation NLL/byte; test untouched
